text: Bei dem Hackathon im Segelclub: Wie kam ich auf die Idee, für jeden Punkt im Watt vorab auszurechnen, bei welchem Wasserstand er zur Insel wird?
why: German cue for the English memory of the tide-safety hackathon.

text: Tu te souviens du courriel trompeur que mon directeur voulait envoyer à la cliente au sujet du module en retard, et que tu as refusé de rédiger ?
why: French cue for the English memory of the refused misleading email.

text: Quand as-tu appris que je ne distingue pas le rouge du vert, et qu'as-tu changé ensuite dans les tableaux de bord ?
why: French cue for the English memory of learning about her colour vision.

text: Dans nos recherches sur mon arrière-arrière-grand-père charpentier de marine, quel document a fini par indiquer qu'il était à bord du navire naufragé ?
why: French cue for the English memory of the family-history search.

text: Lembras-te da semana antes do prazo da candidatura a financiamento, quando quase não dormi e tu me disseste que o mais útil era eu dormir até às oito?
why: Portuguese cue for the English memory of the sleepless grant week.

text: Porque é que falhei a maratona no primeiro ano, e que regra pusemos no plano de treino quando recomecei?
why: Portuguese cue for the English memory of the marathon plan and injury.

text: Como ficou a folha de cálculo do banco alimentar onde faço voluntariado aos sábados, e o que corrigiu a senhora que gere o armazém?
why: Portuguese cue for the English memory of the food bank inventory sheet.

text: 公開リポジトリに決済の秘密鍵をうっかりコミットしてしまったとき、無効にするまで何分かかったんだっけ？
why: Japanese cue for the English memory of the leaked payment key.

text: あなたのメモが見つからなくて、わたしのことを何も覚えていなかった朝、わたしは何を書いて渡した？
why: Japanese cue for the English memory of the morning the notes were missing.

text: 恩師の追悼の会で話すことになったとき、経歴を並べるのをやめて、代わりにどの朝の思い出を語ることにしたんだっけ？
why: Japanese cue for the English memory of the remembrance for Henrik.

text: Remember when you read through my tax return and spotted that Kenji's invoice was counted twice in my freelance income?
why: Direct restatement of the tax-return memory using its own words.

text: How did we put together the toast for my brother Bram's wedding, the one with the bus tickets and the long way to school?
why: Direct restatement of the wedding-toast memory.

text: What went wrong when Callum tried to follow the setup instructions on his first day?
why: Direct restatement of the unusable setup document memory.

text: When did I finally move all my passwords out of the green notebook and into a password manager?
why: Direct restatement of the password-manager memory.

text: That time I shipped the export feature for Kenji's audit without tests and you disagreed: did the tests find a bug the following week?
why: Direct restatement of the overruled-on-tests memory.

text: Which change of Yusra's did you approve even though the customer name was pasted straight into the database query?
why: Direct restatement of the missed-injection review memory.

text: The memory leak in the sync service that turned out not to be a leak at all: what was actually growing?
why: Direct restatement of the three-week leak hunt.

text: How many invoices did the old and new billing systems disagree on the first night we ran them in the shadow?
why: Direct restatement of the billing rewrite memory.

text: What was the first rule we made in our first month of working together: one sentence, not an essay?
why: Direct restatement of the first-month memory.

text: What did my nephew build that summer when you taught him to program, the thing with the buoy readings and the waves?
why: Direct restatement of the nephew's surf-score program memory.

text: In the document called "the question", with its two columns about leaving the city, what was left after you struck through the lines about other people's wishes?
why: Direct restatement of the leaving-the-city memory.

text: When the funding round collapsed and I had to cut four of nine, why wouldn't you give me a ranking?
why: Direct restatement of the layoffs memory.

text: How did I step down as lead maintainer of the tide-table library, and who took over?
why: Direct restatement of the maintainer memory.

text: When we went through the whole year before the winter break, what was the largest group of mistakes you found in the notes?
why: Direct restatement of the year-end review memory.

text: You estimated two days for multi-currency support in the invoicing; how long did it actually take, and why?
why: Direct restatement of the bad-estimate memory.

text: ¿En qué capítulo maté a Baltasar en mi novela, y cómo cambié después la voz que cuenta la historia?
why: Direct restatement of the Spanish novel memory.

text: Woran hättest du vor meiner Auszeit im November merken können, dass ich erschöpft war, und was haben wir danach vereinbart?
why: Direct restatement of the German memory of his time off.

text: Notre désaccord sur le module des échéances, réécrire depuis zéro ou réparer en place : comment l'avons-nous résolu ?
why: Direct restatement of the French rewrite-or-repair disagreement.

text: Na aposta com o meu irmão Duarte sobre o treinador novo, o que é que os números dos jogos em casa mostraram afinal?
why: Direct restatement of the Portuguese football-bet memory.

text: 新しい検索が四倍遅いと報告されたとき、実は開発用の設定のまま計測していたんだったよね？
why: Direct restatement of the Japanese debug-build measurement memory.
